title: NAACP accuses EEOC of stalling on its records request
summary: According to the civil rights organization, the agency used a fee waiver denial to “delay and obstruct” its access to records that are in the public interest.

title: Coalition requests judge halt Trump’s anti-DEI contractor order
summary: The group, led by the National Association of Diversity Officers in Higher Education, filed a lawsuit over the executive order in April.

title: Employers don’t have to build the AI algorithm to own the liability
summary: Some companies and HR leaders assume legal risk lies with the software vendor that created or licensed artificial intelligence tools, but this is often not the case.

title: Trump’s $100K fee for H-1B visas struck down
summary: A federal judge ruled that the fee amounted to an unlawful tax on the visa program for highly skilled workers.

title: Informal mentorships may be the most effective, HR leader says
summary: The added flexibility allows ties to develop organically between mentors and mentees, said Michelle Kilroy, chief people and communications officer at The Weather Co.

title: AI is creating a ‘joy paradox’ at work, BCG finds
summary: Although workers say their job satisfaction is up due to artificial intelligence, they also note an increased cognitive load.

title: People who eagerly seek out managerial positions may be least suited for the roles
summary: Good managers may be more important to overall company success than the combined skills of their teams, but not all are suited for such, per a study.

title: Companies aren’t prepared for how AI is accelerating impersonation attacks, report shows
summary: Businesses generally aren’t taking a proactive enough approach to blocking schemes that spoof their leaders’ identities, security firm Outtake said.

title: EEOC reminds employers the ADA applies despite tech advances
summary: A worker with diabetes was allegedly denied breaks to check his blood sugar and fired after an electronic monitoring system recorded too many breaks.

title: Feds propose mandatory E-Verify participation for federal grant recipients
summary: The rule would provide an “additional safeguard” to existing employment eligibility requirements, according to the White House Office of Management and Budget.
